note: Every published number, its status, the script that reproduces it, and the check that could make it wrong. PASS-1 = one run, provisional, never quoted as settled. PASS-2 = reproduced with a different parameterisation. withdrawn = it was published and then failed; kept so the record shows the retraction. | registered = falsifier and script on record, no run yet

claims.claim: mode count = 8 pi V f^3 / 3 c^3 minus a surface term, fitted against exact enumeration
evidence: room 0.004%
chamber -0.08%
acoustic 0.02%
claims.falsifier: an independent mode count disagreeing by more than 1%

claims.claim: a rectangular space has 77-92% exact mode degeneracies
evidence: room 77.6%
cube 92.1%
chamber 46.6%
claims.falsifier: a space whose measured spacing statistic survives without degeneracy collapse

claims.claim: a 3x4x2.5 m room supports 3-4 of 4 streams at 20 dB (perfect-polarisation ceiling)
evidence: Q 100/200/400 identical
layout sweep 3-4
claims.falsifier: a measured 4x4 link giving fewer than 2 or more than 4 streams

claims.claim: with polarisation the count is 3-4 of 4 at 20 dB, spread one stream across Q=100..400 and three heights
evidence: 27 matrices: Q 100/200/400 x 3 seeds x 3 heights, spread exactly 1 stream
converged in cap to the full 38,985-mode resonance window
claims.falsifier: more than one stream of movement across a factor of four in Q or across height

evidence: matches bisection to 0.00% over 12 V/Q combinations
Q x4 -> cube root of 4
claims.falsifier: a chamber whose measured uniformity onset disagrees with the formula

claims.claim: the 3 x fundamental rule of thumb is optimistic by 1.2-2.0x depending on Q
evidence: computed, never measured in a chamber
claims.falsifier: a measured chamber whose field becomes uniform at or below the rule of thumb

claims.claim: a two-state ambient link needs eta^2 m = 4[Q^-1(eps)]^2 samples (constant corrected from 2)
evidence: Monte Carlo of the stated receiver lands within 1.11x of target on four cases
derivation, with the binary error as Q(sqrt(I)/2)
claims.falsifier: a receiver achieving the target BER with fewer than 4[Q^-1]^2/eta^2 samples

claims.claim: 16-17 of 40 modes are usable at -60 dB with three probes, independent of Q, and the count saturates while the mode count grows 245x
evidence: Q 25/50/100 give exactly the same count in four spaces
modes 147->36096 while usable 11->17
claims.falsifier: a probe count or noise floor that moves the usable count by more than a factor of two

claims.claim: a 4x4 5 GHz link carries 3 of 4 streams at 20 dB, matching practice
claims.reason: the number was a property of the receive layout, not the room; superseded by the 3-4 range in scalar-streams

claims.claim: degree 2 instanton truncation fixes the h12>=5 sampler yield
claims.reason: confounded: maximum_degree=0 silently disables mirror instanton corrections, so the comparison was corrections off vs on

claims.claim: the ISD solve, not the sampler, is the h12>=5 wall
claims.reason: measured by a criterion whose two residual fields disagree by 75 orders of magnitude at the same point

claims.claim: a command reaches the operator only if local, ssh and mesh were tried and none worked
evidence: the 2026-10-31 incident raises
claiming a run with no attempt raises
a working mesh path + asked_operator raises
claims.falsifier: a session that asks the operator to run something while a path exists

claims.claim: lithium mass balance, not cost, caps Li-ion deployment near 3.2 TWh/yr (0.41 kg LCE/kWh at 1.3 Mt LCE world supply)
evidence: computed from USGS 2025 (1.3 Mt LCE) and 5.32 kg LCE per kg Li — one derivation, not two independent lines
claims.falsifier: > 5 TWh/yr of Li-ion from < 1.5 Mt LCE primary supply, with no more than a 2x lithium price rise

claims.claim: Li-S specific energy is set by the electrolyte/sulfur ratio: 680 Wh/kg is the asymptote at r=3 uL/mg, and <= 542 Wh/kg is reachable at q <= 12
evidence: computed from published Li2S constants (2.15 V, 1672 mAh/g) and a materials budget — one derivation
the draft claim said 680 was reachable; this run showed it is the q->infinity asymptote and the finite ceiling is 542
claims.falsifier: any full cell (>= 1 Ah, >= 50 cycles, total mass) measured above 680 Wh/kg at r >= 3 uL/mg

claims.claim: the 0.93 current exponent of IPB98(y,2) is between-machine collinearity; the within-machine exponent is 0.55 +/- 0.12, so ITER needs H98 ~ 1.15
claims.falsifier: a within-machine exponent >= 0.85 (95% CI), or SPARC's first H-mode tau_E within +/-10% of the IPB98 line at 8.7 MA / 12.2 T

claims.claim: conservation drift transfers linearly into ECS (slope 1.0 +/- 0.2; 0.76 K per W/m2), so abrupt-4xCO2 ECS needs a one-line correction
claims.falsifier: a per-model abrupt-4xCO2 fit showing the induced dECS is not linear in the drift residual eps, or a transfer coefficient outside [0.4, 1.2] K per W/m2

claims.claim: verification has a 1-3 uJ floor per check and a crossover at 10^4-10^6 ops per item, above which witness checking beats re-execution
claims.falsifier: a measured floor outside 0.3-10 uJ per check, or a crossover outside 10^3-10^7 ops per item

claims.claim: the tadpole closed form count(N) = [x^N] P(x)^(b3/2) holds at b3 = 8: 43,046,720 primitive orbits, every class matching full enumeration
evidence: full enumeration at b3 = 8 through the numpy pipeline (tadpole_distribution.verify): matches true, 43,046,720 orbits = total_predicted, 194.2 s (job 2026-11-03T1037Z-pacland-rog-b3-8-exact-count)
independent pure-Python nested-loop implementation (no numpy, no polynomial): 43,046,720 orbits, 17 classes, exact match on every class, 69 s (job 2026-11-03T1102Z-pacland-rog-independent-count-b3-8)
claims.falsifier: a third implementation disagreeing at any rung, or a re-run on different hardware producing a different total; the b3 <= 6 agreement is guarded by tests/test_tadpole_independent.py

claims.claim: across 53 CMIP6 models the ECS-per-forcing slope is -0.547 K per W/m2 (95% CI [-1.274, +0.326], R2 0.04) — forcing does not predict ECS across models, so the 0.76 K per W/m2 of the draft energy claim is a ratio of assessed values, not a slope
evidence: OLS + 2000-draw bootstrap on the Zelinka et al. 2020 table (53 models, ECS and ERF2x), computed 2026-11-03 — one dataset, one method
claims.falsifier: a different ECS/ERF2x compilation, or a weighting of the same one, giving a slope above +0.3 with a CI excluding zero
